label: preparing
what: Likely a surprise gathering or celebration in the great hall tomorrow at eighteen hundred, possibly for my forty years of service. Innkeeper and freight are arranging two hundred fresh loaves and a committee fund of 174 emeralds; builder is arranging eight lanterns and table layout and securing my attendance under the description of a routine lighting inspection. The gathering's true purpose has not been disclosed to me; secretary has reported the arrangements but is not clearly a knowing participant.
